description: Use this when you have a company name, ticker, government entity, sector or topic and need the matching DaallIndex record. Searches listed companies, the largest government buyers, the indices and the research notes. Returns up to 10 results as {id, title, url}, with ids in the form company:<ticker>, buyer:<id>, index:<code> or research:<id>. ابحث باسم شركة أو رمزها أو جهة حكومية أو قطاع أو موضوع.
